note: Key cards for the Phase 3 hand tool (src/tools/goldfish.ts), measured for deck A (Rakdos Midrange) in the keep branch. Each entry is a proportion of games with a Wilson 95 percent interval. how: 'lands' = controls at least 'count' lands by its own turn 'byTurn'; 'cast' = cast one of 'cards' by its own turn 'byTurn'; 'battlefield' = one of 'cards' on the battlefield by then. Card names are the decklist names (a front-face name also works). Bonecrusher Giant counts as removal because by own turn 2 only its Stomp half is castable. Edit this file to change the list; no code change is needed.
